project.name: Member invitations
project.description: An exported function authorizes an administrator, creates a pending invitation, sends it through an injected mailer, and removes it if delivery fails.

analysis.scope: Agent-generated analysis of examples/invitations/invitations.js. Only this module and its injected dependency interfaces are in scope.
limitations: Static source analysis, not a runtime trace or a recovery of complete business requirements.

No callers, UI, API routes, transport, tests, configuration or dependency implementations are present. The conceptual requester interaction is inferred; HTTP serving is not established by numeric status fields.
Directory.find/save/remove and mailer.send are injected objects. Storage durability, lookup semantics beyond truthiness, email transport behavior, and invitation acceptance are unknown.
The code assumes actor.role and email.includes can be accessed; it provides no general input validation or full email syntax validation.

Directory lookup and save occur before the try block, so their exceptions are not caught. A failed cleanup can propagate instead of returning 502; these exception paths are omitted from the diagrams because dependency behavior is absent.
No retry, concurrency control, atomic transaction or duplicate-race prevention is demonstrated. No use-case relationships are asserted from helper calls.
The returned invite is whatever directory.save supplies; its existence and id shape are assumed by the function.

evidence.reason: Exported invitation function and injected dependencies.
Administrator role required; other roles return 403.
Persist pending invitation before delivery try/catch.
Attempt awaited mail delivery using saved invitation id.
Delivery catch removes saved record and then returns 502.

useCases.name: Invite a member
useCases.goal: Create and deliver a pending member invitation as an administrator.
preconditions: Caller supplies actor, email and directory/mailer dependencies.
Successful creation requires actor.role == admin, email including @, and a falsy directory.find(email) result.
postconditions: Success: pending invitation is saved, mailer.send resolves, and status 201 plus invite is returned.
Rejected authorization, format or duplicate checks return 403, 400 or 409 before save and send.
Delivery failure with successful cleanup: saved invitation is removed, then status 502 is returned.

scenarios.outcome: Returns status 201 and the persisted invitation.
